scripts.start:https: NITRO_SSL_CERT="$(cat data/tls/cert.pem)" NITRO_SSL_KEY="$(cat data/tls/key.pem)" HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 node .output/server/index.mjs
scripts.cert: mkdir -p data/tls && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 3650 -subj /CN=tape-twist -keyout data/tls/key.pem -out data/tls/cert.pem
scripts.test:e2e: TAPE_TWIST_E2E=1 nuxt build && vitest run -c vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.android:apk:local: cap sync android && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug) && mkdir -p data && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk data/tape-twist.apk
